leo: Quick question re: cap-gap -> H-1B transfer timing. I9m currently on OPT (EAD through Aug 15) and got an offer with a June 1 start. My employer is filing H-1B transfer (cap-subject) and we9re planning premium processing but biometrics/consulate could still take time. If transfer/visa stamping isn9t complete, what happens to benefits enrollment and PTO accrual?

maria (People Ops): @leo good flag. Short answer: benefits enrollment and PTO accrual kick in once you9re an active employee on payroll (i.e., I-9 complete and payroll record created). We can9t enroll someone who isn9t authorized to work at start of payroll.

leo: Is there any way to preserve the enrollment window? My partner needs health coverage asap.

immigration-legal: If you qualify for cap-gap (pending H-1 petition with requested change of status), you may have work authorization automatically extended until Oct 1. That can let you start on payroll if the cap-gap is in effect and documented. We9ll need the receipt notice (I-797C) showing cap-gap language.

sanjay (Recruiter): We9re planning premium processing so timeline is usually 15 calendar days, but the consulate stamp after approval can add 1-3 weeks.

leo: Suppose cap-gap doesn9t apply. Could I start "unpaid" and still get benefits later?

maria (People Ops): We can onboard you as non-pay (account + Slack + LMS) and let you attend training, but benefits and PTO won9t accrue until payroll hire date. Equity paperwork can be signed now and the grant will reference the official hire date.

leo: Any options for retroactive enrollment if I9m put on payroll later?

payroll-bot: Note: payroll deadlines are 25th of month for next-month pay. Retroactive payroll additions require proof of authorization before cutoff and legal signoff.

maria (People Ops): We can sometimes set the payroll hire date to match the original offer date if immigration docs are finalized within payroll9s cutoff and legal approves. That preserves benefits effective date and accruals as if you started earlier. But it9s not guaranteed.

immigration-legal: Also consider short-term bridge coverage in your partner9s plan (COBRA/COBRA alternative) or marketplace plans for the gap. We can share referrals to a benefits broker.

leo: Thanks. Two more practical asks: 1) can Redwood accept a consular approval PDF + I-797 to do remote I-9? 2) Is there a standard travel letter for stamping?

maria (People Ops): 1) Yes, we can accept scanned approval docs for remote onboarding; originals must be inspected by an authorized representative when you return to US (we'll use the authorized-rep form). 2) I9ll attach a travel letter template below and a short checklist.

maria (People Ops): ```
To: Consular Officer
Subject: Employment verification for visa stamping
Name: Leo Alvarez
Position: Senior Backend Engineer (Full-time)
Proposed start: June 1, 2026
Employer: Redwood Inference, Inc.
We confirm the above-named individual has a bona fide permanent job offer and supporting documentation is available upon request. Contact hr@redwood.com for verification.
```

maria (People Ops): Checklist: scanned passport page, I-797 (if approved), receipt notice (I-797C) if pending, offer letter, upload to candidate portal. I9ll DM the authorized-rep form.

leo: Great. If we do onboarding-only, will my manager be billed for IT laptop provisioning early?

sanjay (Recruiter): Good Q. Typically IT will provision soft access (email, Slack) without hardware until payroll starts. If you need a laptop before payroll, request manager approval; it9s treated as asset loan and a cost center gets billed.

maria (People Ops): Action items: @leo upload any USCIS receipts or approvals to the portal; @immigration-legal to confirm whether cap-gap applies; @payroll-bot to flag payroll cutoff rules to the recruiter and manager.

immigration-legal: Also note: if you travel abroad while petition pending, it can impact change-of-status cases. If you9re planning consular processing, share travel dates and we9ll advise.

leo: Uploaded receipt notice and offer acceptance. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria (People Ops): Received. We9ll tentatively schedule onboarding-only access on June 1 and hold payroll until we have either cap-gap documentation or H-1 approval + I-9 originals. Will update in this thread.

payroll-bot: Reminder: new hire packet (W-4, direct deposit, benefits) will auto-send once payroll hire date is set.

leo: Appreciate the quick turnaround. I9ll keep you posted after premium processing update.
